qe: Which fat-soluble vitamin acts as an essential cofactor for hepatic blood coagulation factors?
qh: कौन सा वसा-घुलनशील विटामिन यकृत में रक्त के थक्के जमाने वाले कारकों के संश्लेषण के लिए अनिवार्य है?
e: Concept: Khoon ka jamna (blood clotting) ek chain reaction hai jisme liver kai khaas proteins (clotting factors - II, VII, IX, X) banata hai, aur unko kaam karne ke liye ek cofactor chahiye - Vitamin K (green leafy sabzi, dahi, aant ke bacteria se milta hai). Iski kami se khoon der se jamta hai (ya bahut riste hue bachche me bleeding ho jati hai), isliye naye bacche ko Vitamin K ka injection diya jata hai. Baaki teen alag kaam karte hain: Vitamin A (dekhna), D (haddi), E (antioxidant). Exam point: 'Khoon jamne wala vitamin = Vitamin K (liver ke clotting factors ka cofactor)'.

qe: Deficiency of which fat-soluble vitamin causes Xerophthalmia and Nyctalopia (Night Blindness)?
qh: किस विटामिन की कमी से रतौंधी (Night Blindness) और आँख की शुष्कता (Xerophthalmia) होती है?
e: Concept: Vitamin A (retinol) ki kami se aankh ki retina ka 'rhodopsin' theek nahi banta - isse pehle raat/dhundhle roshni me dikhna kam ho jata hai (Nyctalopia/night blindness) aur aage chal kar aankh ki safed patti soonkhi ho kar kharab ho jati hai (Xerophthalmia) - khaas kar chhote bachchon me. Baaki teen is kami se nahi hote: Vitamin K (khoon jamna), Vitamin C (scurvy), Vitamin B12 (blood/nerve). Exam point: 'Raat me kam dikhna + aankh soonkhna (Xerophthalmia/Nyctalopia) = Vitamin A ki kami'.

qe: Who is universally recognized as the classical 'Father of Biology' and 'Father of Zoology'?
qh: प्राचीन काल के किस दार्शनिक को 'जीव विज्ञान' और 'जंतु विज्ञान' का जनक कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Arastu (Aristotle, Greece ke 350 BC ke) ko 'Father of Biology' aur 'Father of Zoology' kaha jata hai kyunki unhone pehli baar jeevon ko theen tarah se dekha-classify kiya aur janwaron ke bare me (History of Animals) bada kaam kiya; unke shagird Theophrastus ne paudhon par wahi kaam kiya, isliye unhe 'Father of Botany' kehte hain. Baaki teen alag scientists hain: Darwin (evolution), Theophrastus (botany ke janak), Lamarck (early evolution theory). Exam point: 'Biology/Zoology ke janak = Aristotle (Arastu); Botany ke janak = Theophrastus'.

qe: What is the full biochemical name of the diagnostic immunoassay 'ELISA' used to screen for HIV antibodies?
qh: एचआईवी (HIV) की प्रारंभिक पहचान के लिए प्रयुक्त 'एलिसा' (ELISA) परीक्षण का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e: Concept: ELISA ek 'immunoassay' (immunity wali rasaaynik jaanch) hai jo khoon me kisi bimari ke antibodies ya antigen ki maujoodgi pakadti hai - iska poora naam Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay hai; isme enzyme se juda antibody ek rang badalne wali (color) reaction deta hai, jisse pata chalta hai ki HIV (ya HIV antibody) hai ya nahi. Isliye ye HIV, hepatitis aur kai bimariyon ki screening ka aam test hai. Baaki teen options me se koi bhi bio-medical term nahi hai (full form invented). Exam point: 'ELISA = Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay (HIV antibody screening test)'.

qe: The cytotoxic anthracycline chemotherapy drug famously nicknamed the 'Red Devil' due to its bright color and cardiac toxicity is:
qh: कीमोथेरेपी में प्रयुक्त होने वाली वह कौन सी दवा है जिसे उसके गहरे लाल रंग और विषाक्तता के कारण 'रेड डेविल' कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Cancer ke ili me kai rasayan (chemo) wali dawaoyen di jati hain; unme ek khaas dawa hai Adriamycin (Doxorubicin) - ye ek anthracycline antibiotic hai jo cancer cells ka DNA todkar unhe marta hai, isliye ye khaas hai; uska rang laal (bright red) hota hai aur uske injection ke baad mareez ka peshab bhi laal ho jata hai, aur uske dil par zeher (cardiac toxicity) ka khatra hota hai - isliye nurses ise bahut savdhani se dete hain aur usse 'Red Devil' (laal shaitan) kehte hain (par ye bahut kaam ki dawa hai). Baaki teen alag chemo dawaoyen hain: Paclitaxel, Cisplatin, Methotrexate. Exam point: "'Red Devil' chemo drug = Adriamycin (Doxorubicin)".

qe: Normal Saline (NS 0.9%) intravenous solution contains which precise concentration of Sodium Chloride in sterile water?
qh: अस्पतालों में निर्जलीकरण दूर करने के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले नॉर्मल सेलाइन (NS) में NaCl की कितनी सांद्रता होती है?
e: Concept: 'Normal Saline' matlab namak (NaCl) ka ek aisa ghol jiska concentration bilkul khoon ke plasma jitna ho - 0.9% w/v (yaani 1 litre paani me 9 gram namak); ise 'isotonic' kehte hain, isliye ye injection/IV ke roop me diya jata hai aur ye khoon ki RBCs ko na soch ko na sundhate (phoolakar phodta) hain. Isi wajah se ise 'normal' kaha jata hai. Baaki teen concentration galat hain: 10% bahut tez namak hai, 0.45% aadha (hypotonic), aur 5% dextrose ka hota hai. Exam point: 'Normal saline = 0.9% NaCl (isotonic with blood plasma)'.

qe: The intravenous crystalloid solution termed 'DNS' represents a pharmacological combination of:
qh: चिकित्सा में प्रयुक्त 'डीएनएस' (DNS) बोतल किन दो आवश्यक घटकों का मिश्रण होती है?
e: Concept: DNS ek aam IV fluid hai jiska poora matlab 'Dextrose Normal Saline' hai - isme do cheezein mili hoti hain: 5% Dextrose (glucose, energy ke liye) aur 0.9% Normal Saline (namak-paani balance ke liye). Isliye ye mareez ko paani, namak aur thodi energy teeno deta hai (kamzori/dehydration me). Baaki teen milavat galat hain: Dialysis fluid alag hota hai, Dopamine ek dawa hai (fluid nahi), aur Ringer's Lactate alag fluid hai. Exam point: 'DNS = Dextrose 5% + Normal Saline 0.9% (dono mila hua IV fluid)'.

qe: The BCG (Bacillus Calmette-Guérin) pediatric vaccine is administered to infants to build active immunity against:
qh: शिशुओं को जन्म के समय दिया जाने वाला 'बीसीजी' (BCG) का टीका किस संक्रामक बीमारी से बचाता है?
e: Concept: BCG (Bacillus Calmette-Guerin) duniya ka sabse purana aur sabse zyada lagaya jaane wala vaccine hai - isme TB (Tuberculosis) ke bacteria ki kamzor (attenuated) nasal di jati hai, aur ise naye bacche ke kandhe/chamdi par lagaya jata hai (ek chhota nishaan banta hai). Iska asar bachche ko TB se bachata hai (aur khaas kar dimagi TB/meningitis se). Baaki teen alag vaccines hain: Pertussis aur Diphtheria DPT me, Poliomyelitis OPV/IPV me. Exam point: 'BCG vaccine = TB (Tuberculosis) se bachav; janm par lagta hai, nishaan banta hai'.

qe: A rigid, custom-molded thermoplastic 'Orfit' mask is used in oncology clinical radiotherapy to:
qh: कैंसर के मरीजों की रेडिएशन थेरेपी के दौरान 'ऑर्फिट' (Orfit) मास्क का उपयोग किसलिए किया जाता है?
o: Cool the scalp to prevent alopecia
Immobilize the head and neck to ensure sub-millimeter beam targeting
e: Concept: Radio-therapy (radiation se cancer ka ilaaj) me sabse badi chunauti ye hai ki maareez hil na jaye - warna radiation sahi jagah nahi pahunchti aur aas-paas ke ang (brainstem, spinal cord, aankh) jal sakte hain. Isliye oncologist ek khaas 'Orfit' (thermoplastic) ki dikhne wali mask (Orfit mask) banate hain jo sir-gale par fitting se chadhti hai aur mareez ko operator table par bilkul jakad (immobilize) deti hai - taaki humesha ek hi position me 'sub-millimeter' (bahut bareek) precision se beam pahunch sake. Baaki teen iske kaam nahi hain (oxygen dena, sar thanda karna, X-ray scatter rokna). Exam point: 'Orfit mask = head-neck ko immobilize karke radiotherapy ki precision dena'.

qe: Which prophylactic quadrivalent or nonavalent vaccine is administered to adolescents to prevent Cervical Cancer?
qh: महिलाओं में गर्भाशय ग्रीवा के कैंसर (Cervical Cancer) की रोकथाम के लिए कौन सा टीका लगाया जाता है?
e: Concept: Cervical cancer (garbhashay ke muh ka cancer) sabse zyada Human Papillomavirus (HPV) - khaas kar HPV-16, 18 - se hota hai; isliye HPV vaccine (quadrivalent ya nonavalent) ladkiyon-ladkon ko 9-14 saal ki umar me, sex shuru hone se pehle lagayi jati hai, jo cervical/uterine cancer se bachata hai. Baaki teen vaccines alag bimariyon ke liye hain: MMR (khasra-mumps-rubella), BCG (TB), Rotavirus (dast/diarhhea). Exam point: 'Cervical cancer ka vaccine = HPV (quadrivalent/nonavalent, 9-14 saal me)'.

qe: Which pediatric immunization is known as the 'Triple Antigen' vaccine because it protects against Diphtheria, Pertussis, and Tetanus?
qh: डिप्थीरिया, काली खांसी और टिटनेस से एक साथ सुरक्षा देने वाले किस टीके को 'ट्रिपल एंटीजन' कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: DPT vaccine ek hi injection me teen bimariyon se bachata hai - isliye ise 'Triple Antigen' kehte hain: D = Diphtheria (gale me parda banne wali bimari), P = Pertussis (kali khansi - whooping cough), T = Tetanus (dhunchuna - khaas kar ghaav lagne par). Isme poori killed bacteria ke antigen hote hain, isliye chhote bachchon me (6 weeks se) 3 khuraak di jaati hain. Baaki teen alag vaccines hain: MMR (khasra/mumps/rubella), OPV (polio), BCG (TB). Exam point: 'Triple antigen vaccine = DPT (Diphtheria-Pertussis-Tetanus)'.

qe: Who formulated the first formal 'Vitamin Theory' and coined the biochemical term 'Vitamine' in 1912?
qh: 1912 में कार्बनिक सूक्ष्म पोषक तत्वों के लिए 'विटामिन' (Vitamin) शब्द किसने गढ़ा और सिद्धांत प्रस्तुत किया?
e: Concept: 1912 me ek Poland ke biochemist Casimir Funk ne sabse pehle ye saaf kaha ki kuch bimariyan khaane me maujood khaas maatra (micro-nutrients) ki kami se hoti hain, aur unhe usne 'Vitamine' naam diya (life = vita + amine) - kyunki usne socha tha ye khaas padarth amine hote hain; yahi aajkal ka 'Vitamin' shabd hai (baad me pata chala sab vitamins amine nahi hote). Baaki teen scientists kaam alag tha: Hopkins (vitamin theory ke bhi pioneer), Eijkman (beriberi- B1), Lunin (vitamin ke experiments). Exam point: "'Vitamine' shabd (1912) = Casimir Funk".

qe: Following the 'WBC' mnemonic (Water: B & C), which group of vitamins is physiologically water-soluble?
qh: 'WBC' सूत्र के अनुसार कौन से विटामिन जल में घुलनशील (Water-Soluble) होते हैं और मूत्र के साथ बाहर निकल जाते हैं?
o: Vitamins A, D, E, and K
e: Concept: 'WBC' mnemonic se W = Water aur B, C = wahi vitamins jo paani me ghulte hain - matlab Water-soluble = B-Complex (B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B7, B9, B12) aur Vitamin C. Ye paani me ghulne wale vitamins sharir me jud nahi paate - zyada hone par peshab se nikal jate hain aur kami jaldi ho jati hai (isliye har din khaana padta hai). Baaki teen options fat-soluble (A, D, E, K) wale hain jo charbi/liver me jama ho jate hain. Exam point: 'Water-soluble = B-Complex + C (roz zaroori); Fat-soluble = A, D, E, K (liver me jama)'.

qe: Which vitamin functions like a secosteroid hormone, being photo-synthesized in skin epidermis via UVB solar radiation?
qh: सूर्य के प्रकाश (UVB) की उपस्थिति में त्वचा द्वारा संश्लेषित होने वाला कौन सा विटामिन एक 'स्टेरॉयड हार्मोन' की तरह कार्य करता है?
e: Concept: Vitamin D (Cholecalciferol) ko khaas 'secosteroid hormone' kaha jata hai kyunki ye hormone ki tarah kaam karta hai (aant se calcium-khahar ka sochan, haddi me calcium jama) aur iska bada hissa khud sharir me banta hai: chamdi (skin epidermis) me UVB dhoop padne se cholesterol-like padarth se Vitamin D banta hai (isliye 'sunlight vitamin' kehte hain). Iski kami se bachchon me rakhitis aur bado me osteomalacia hoti hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Vitamin A (dekhna), C (immunity/ghaav), E (antioxidant). Exam point: 'Dhoop (UVB) se chamdi me banta Vitamin D = sunshine vitamin; kami se rickets'.

qe: Which water-soluble micronutrient is notoriously thermolabile, easily destroyed by boiling, cooking, or peeling?
qh: कौन सा विटामिन अत्यधिक ताप-संवेदी (Heat-sensitive) होता है और खाना पकाने या उबालने पर सबसे पहले नष्ट हो जाता है?
e: Concept: Vitamin C (Ascorbic acid) paani me ghulta hai aur garmi (heat) se turant tut jata hai - isliye sabzi/fal ko zyada uthaalna (boil karna), peel karna ya khola rakhna isko barbaad karta hai (bahut hissa paani me chala jata hai). Isi wajah se kam suraksha wale samudri yatriyo me scurvy (masoodh se khoon, ghumhav, ghaav thik na hona) hoti thi, aur aaj bhi khaane ka dhyan rakha jata hai - kaccha fal/salad khana. Baaki teen fat-soluble hain jo garmi se utne nahi tutate: K, A, D. Exam point: 'Sabse thermolabile (garmi se tutne wala) vitamin = Vitamin C (ascorbic acid); kami se scurvy'.

qe: Vitamin E (Alpha-tocopherol) is popularly designated the 'Beauty Vitamin' and 'Anti-Sterility Vitamin' because it:
qh: विटामिन E (टोकोफेरॉल) को 'सौंदर्य विटामिन' (Beauty Vitamin) क्यों कहा जाता है?
o: Acts as a potent lipid antioxidant protecting cutaneous cell membranes from free radicals
e: Concept: Vitamin E (Alpha-tocopherol) ek mukhya 'antioxidant' hai - ye cell ki membrane (charbi wali parat) me rehkar free radicals (bielectric tootane wale aakariyaan) ko bekaar karta hai, isliye skin ki cells ko bura hone se bacha kar uski chamak banaye rakhta hai aur zukhaam set karne (sterility) se banata hai - isiliye ise 'Beauty Vitamin' aur 'Anti-sterility Vitamin' kehte hain. Baaki teen galat kaam hain: haddi ka apatite banana (calcium/Vit D ka kaam), chamdi ki upar wali patti nikalna (skin turnover - Vitamin A), aur melanin ko safed karna (aisa nahi hota). Exam point: 'Beauty/Anti-sterility vitamin = Vitamin E (antioxidant, membrane ki suraksha)'.

qe: Which member of the Vitamin B-complex family is chemically named 'Riboflavin' and forms FMN/FAD prosthetic groups?
qh: विटामिन B-समूह के किस सदस्य का रासायनिक नाम 'राइबोफ्लेविन' (Riboflavin) है जो माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया के श्वसन में भाग लेता है?
e: Concept: Vitamin B2 ka rasaynath naam Riboflavin hai - kyunki iska rang peela (latin: flavus) hota hai; ye sharir me do khaas co-proteins banata hai: FMN aur FAD - jo energy banane wali cell ke andar ki chain (electron transport aur kai enzyme reactions) ke liye zaroori hain; iski kami se hothon ke kon me dard, khaali, aur jabaan ki soojh hoti hai (aur peshab peela ho jata hai). Baaki teen B-vitamins alag naam waale hain: B3 Niacin, B5 Pantothenic acid, B1 Thiamine. Exam point: 'Vitamin B2 = Riboflavin (FMN/FAD ka hissa, peela rang)'.

qe: Vitamin B7, essential for carboxylation enzymes in fatty acid synthesis and gluconeogenesis, is also known as:
qh: बालों और नाखूनों के स्वास्थ्य के लिए आवश्यक विटामिन B7 का दूसरा प्रचलित नाम क्या है?
e: Concept: Vitamin B7 ko Vitamin H (H = Haar aur Haut - German me baal aur chamdi) kehte hain aur uska rasaynath naam Biotin hai - ye kai carboxylase enzymes ka hissa hai jo fatty acid banana aur gluconeogenesis (naya glucose banana) me madad karte hain; iski kami se chamdi ki soojh, baal jhadna aur susti hoti hai. Baaki teen galat/vitamin H nahi hain: P (bioflavonoid), M ka matlab Folic acid (B9), G (B2 ka purana naam). Exam point: 'Vitamin B7 = Vitamin H = Biotin (carboxylation enzymes; baal-chamdi ke liye)'.

qe: Where are excess quantities of fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K) primarily stored in the human body?
qh: मानव शरीर में वसा में घुलनशील विटामिन (A, D, E, K) मुख्य रूप से किस अंग में संचित रहते हैं?
e: Concept: Fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K) paani me nahi ghulte, isliye jo zyada matra kha li jaye wo peshab se bahar nahi jaati - sharir use Tike rehne ke liye rakhta hai: mukhya jaga Liver (hepatic tissue) hai, aur thodi adhish hissa adipose (charbi) tissue me jama ho jata hai; isi wajah se in vitamins ko zyada lena zehreela (toxic) ho sakta hai. Baaki teen organs in vitamins ko zyada na rakhte: Spleen, Pancreas, Kidney. Exam point: 'Fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K) ka store = Liver + adipose (charbi) tissue'.

qe: How many standard, genetically encoded alpha-amino acids polymerize to construct all functional human proteins?
qh: मानव शरीर में सभी प्रोटीनों के निर्माण के लिए कितने प्रकार के मानक अमीनो एसिड (Amino Acids) की आवश्यकता होती है?
e: Concept: Protein kai amino acids ki mala (chain) hoti hai - aur humare DNA (genetic code) me standard taur par sirf 20 hi amino acids ke codon likhe hue hain; inhi 20 se saare human proteins (muscle, enzyme, hormone, antibodies) bante hain (kuch modified versions baad me bante hain, par base 20 hi hai). Baaki teen numbers galat hain: 10 (aadhe), 64 (codon ki kulya sankhya - 4 ka 3 ghan), 15 (kuch nahi). Exam point: 'Standard genetically-encoded amino acids = 20 (baaki species me modified ho sakte hain)'.

qe: The structural exoskeleton of arthropods (cockroaches) and the cell walls of fungi are made of which polymer of N-acetylglucosamine?
qh: कीटों (तिलचट्टा) का बाह्य कंकाल और कवकों की कोशिका भित्ति किस कठोर पॉलीसैकराइड से बनी होती है?
e: Concept: Arthropods (keede-makodi, jhinga, kira) ka bahari hard dhaancha (exoskeleton) chitin se banta hai - ye N-acetylglucosamine ka polymer (bahut saare units ka joda) hai; yahi padarth fungi (mushroom ke family) ki cell wall me bhi hota hai - isliye ye bahut mazboot aur halka hai (aur biotech me isse bandage/dhaaga banate hain). Baaki teen alag polymers hain: Keratin (baal-nakh), Pectin (paudhon ke fal me), Cellulose (paudhon ki cell wall me). Exam point: 'Keeton ka exoskeleton + fungi ki cell wall = Chitin (N-acetylglucosamine polymer)'.

qe: Which fibrous triple-helical structural protein constitutes the most abundant protein in the human body and animal kingdom?
qh: मानव शरीर और संपूर्ण जंतु जगत में सबसे प्रचुर मात्रा में पाया जाने वाला संयोजी ऊतक प्रोटीन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Collagen ek fibrous protein hai jo teen polypeptide chain mil kar ek mota 'triple helix' (rangeen rassi) jaisa dhanca banata hai - yahi insaan (aur poori animal kingdom) ka sabse zyada matra wala protein hai: ye chamdi, haddi, tendons, cartilage, khoon ki nadiyon ki deewar, aur aankh ke cornea me hota hai (isliye chot par cell nayi collagen banti hai). Budhape me iska kam horna jhurriyan banata hai. Baaki teen alag proteins hain: Keratin (baal-nakh), Hemoglobin (khoon me oxygen), Myosin (muscle). Exam point: 'Animal kingdom ka sabse zyada matra wala protein = Collagen'.

qe: Which branched polysaccharide represents the primary storage carbohydrate in humans ('Animal Starch'), stored in the liver and muscle?
qh: अतिरिक्त ग्लूकोज को यकृत और मांसपेशियों में संचित करने वाले 'जंतु स्टार्च' (Animal Starch) को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Paudhe apna khaana (glucose) 'starch' ke roop me rakhte hain; insaan (aur janwar) wahi kaam apne khaas polysaccharide se karte hain - Glycogen ('animal starch') - jo glucose ki bahut jati hui (branched) chain hoti hai; ye liver aur muscle me jama rehta hai aur zaroorat (bhookh/exercise) par turant glucose me tootkar khoon me mil jata hai (isiliye ye 'readily available energy' hai). Baaki teen alag carbohydrates hain: Starch (paudhon me), Cellulose (paudhon ki deewar - insaan pac nahi sakta), Inulin (kuch paudhon me). Exam point: 'Insaan ka storage carbohydrate = Glycogen (liver + muscle me)'.

qe: Steroid hormones (testosterone, estrogen, cortisol) are chemically synthesized from which lipophilic steroid precursor?
qh: सभी स्टेरॉयड हार्मोन (जैसे टेस्टोस्टेरोन, एस्ट्रोजन और कोर्टिसोल) रासायनिक रूप से किससे संश्लेषित होते हैं?
e: Concept: Steroid hormones - Testosterone, Estrogen, Progesterone, Cortisol - saare ek hi base se bante hain: Cholesterol (charbi wala) - isliye ye 'lipid-soluble' hormones hain jo cell ki membrane se seedha ghuskar andar ka receptor pakadte hain aur gene ko chalu karte hain; inke banne ka kaam adrenal cortex, ovaries aur testes karte hain. Baaki teen galat hain: Lecithin (membrane lipid), Glycogen (carbohydrate - energy), Albumin (khoon ka protein). Exam point: 'Saare steroid hormones (cortisol, testosterone, estrogen) = Cholesterol se bante hain'.

qe: Subcutaneous adipose tissue provides significant thermal defense by acting as an effective physiological:
qh: त्वचा के नीचे पाई जाने वाली वसा की परत (Adipose Tissue) शरीर को ठंड से बचाने के लिए किसका कार्य करती है?
e: Concept: Chamdi ke neeche jama charbi (subcutaneous adipose tissue) ek 'thermos flask' ki tarah kaam karti hai - ye garmi ko bahar jaane nahi deti aur thand me sharir ka temperature barabar rakhne me madad karti hai; isi wajah se patle log thand me jaldi kangte hain aur unche polaar wale janwar (whale, seal) moti charbi ki parat (blubber) rakhte hain. Baaki teen kaam nahi: Osmotic pump, Electrical conductor, Refractory barrier. Exam point: 'Charbi ki parat ka garmi bachane ka kaam = Thermal insulator'.

qe: What does the mnemonic '3F' signify regarding the hormonal functions of the Adrenal Medulla?
qh: एड्रिनल ग्रंथि के स्रावों के संबंध में '3F' का क्या अर्थ है?
e: Concept: Adrenal gland do hisson me bat jaati hai - cortex (bahar, cortisol etc.) aur medulla (andar). Adrenal Medulla 'emergency' ka hissa hai: khatre ya dar ke waqt ye Adrenaline (aur noradrenaline) chhodta hai, jisse 3F (Fight, Flight, Fear) wali halat banti hai - dil tez, saans tez, muscles ko zyada energy, pupille failna, aur mareez 'ladho ya bhaago' ke mood me aa jata hai (isse 'emergency hormone' bhi kehte hain). Baaki teen full forms kuch bhi biological matlab nahi rakhte. Exam point: 'Adrenal medulla ke 3F = Fear, Fight, Flight (adrenaline ka asar)'.

qe: The central body cavity bounded by the rib cage, sternum, and diaphragm housing the heart and lungs is the:
qh: पसलियों, स्टर्नम और डायाफ्राम से घिरी वह गुहा जिसमें हृदय और फेफड़े सुरक्षित रहते हैं:
e: Concept: Chhati (thorax) ke andar ki jaga - thoracic cavity - ko seene ki pasliyan, sternum (chhavi ki haddi) aur neeche se Diaphragm gherei rehti hai; isme dil (beech me thoda bayen), phephde, trachea, esophagus ki upar ki part aur thyme-us aate hain. Isse niche wale abdomen se Diaphragm alag karta hai. Baaki teen cavities doosri jagah hain: Abdominal (pet), Pelvic (koolhe ka neeche), Cranial (sar ki khokhli). Exam point: 'Dil + phephde ki jaga (pasli-sternum-diaphragm se gheri) = Thoracic cavity'.

qe: The bony neurocranial cavity within the skull that encloses, cushions, and protects the human brain is the:
qh: खोपड़ी के अंदर का वह सुरक्षित अस्थि कक्ष जो मस्तिष्क को थामे रखता है:
e: Concept: Sar ki haddiyan (khaas kar neurocranium) mil kar ek hard dibba - cranial cavity (khopdi) - banati hain jisme brain safe rehta hai; isme brain ke saath meninges aur CSF bhi hote hain, jo usko takkar se bachate hain, aur iske neeche se foramen magnum se spinal cord bahar nikalti hai. Baaki teen cavities alag hain: Nasal fossa (naak), Orbital (aankh ke khuhe), Buccal (muh). Exam point: 'Brain ki protective khokhli = Cranial cavity'.

qe: Which major hepatic plasma protein maintains capillary colloid osmotic pressure and transports minerals, hormones, and drugs?
qh: यकृत द्वारा निर्मित कौन सा मुख्य प्लाज्मा प्रोटीन रक्त का ऑस्मोटिक दबाव बनाए रखता है और खनिजों का परिवहन करता है?
e: Concept: Albumin khoon ke plasma ka sabse zyada matra wala protein hai; iska bahut khaas kaam hai 'colloid osmotic pressure' (khoon ke andar paani ko kheench kar rakhna) - agar ye kam ho jaye to paani naliyon se bahar tissue me aa jata hai aur soojh (edema) hoti hai - aur iske saath ye kai cheezein (hormones, dawaayen, minerals, bilirubin) ko utha kar pahunchata hai. Baaki teen bhi plasma proteins hain par alag kaam: Prothrombin (khoon jamna), Globulin (antibody/transport), Fibrinogen (clot ka jaal). Exam point: 'Khoon ka colloid osmotic pressure + transport = Serum albumin (plasma ka sabse zyada protein)'.

qe: Human Leukocyte Antigen (HLA) typing and tissue cross-matching is clinically paramount prior to which procedure?
qh: अंग अस्वीकृति (Graft Rejection) को रोकने के लिए अंग या बोन मैरो प्रत्यारोपण से पहले कौन सा मिलान अनिवार्य है?
e: Concept: HLA (Human Leukocyte Antigen) humare cells ke upar lage 'pehchan patra' (tissue type/identity card) hote hain; transplant (ang daan) me agar donor aur mareez ke HLA match nahi hue to mareez ki immunity naye ang ko bahari samajh kar hamla kar deti hai (rejection) - isliye pehle HLA typing aur cross-matching zaroori hai, khaas kar kidney, bone marrow me (blood group ABO se alag ye ek gehri genetic jaanch hai). Baaki teen me HLA ka roz kaam nahi: Lipid profile (cholesterol), routine ABO (sirf blood group), Mantoux (TB skin test). Exam point: 'HLA typing/cross-matching = organ ya bone marrow transplant se pehle (rejection rokne ke liye)'.

qe: Why do health guidelines strictly recommend monitoring and reducing refined free sugar intake beyond age 30?
qh: 30 वर्ष की आयु के बाद रिफाइंड सफेद चीनी के सेवन पर कड़ा नियंत्रण रखने की सलाह क्यों दी जाती है?
o: Basal metabolic rate drops and peripheral insulin sensitivity progressively declines
e: Concept: 30 saal ke baad aam taur par sharir ki 'josh' (BMR - basal metabolic rate) girta jaata hai aur cells ki insulin ke prati sanvedansheelata (insulin sensitivity) kam hoti jaati hai; isliye itni hi chini khane par bhi khoon me sugar zyada der tak rehti hai aur charbi/wajan badhta hai, isliye health guidelines 30+ ki umar me free sugar (chai/meetha/cold drinks) kam karne ki salah deti hain aur vyayam karne ki kehti hain (Type-2 diabetes ka khatra kam karne ke liye). Baaki teen galat hain: gastric acid poori tarah band, enamel ka ayunan, bile ka zero ho jana - aisa nahi hota. Exam point: '30+ me chini kam = BMR aur insulin sensitivity ka girna (diabetes/charbi ka khatra)'.

qe: Why does a medical professional meticulously expel air bubbles from a syringe prior to administering an intravenous injection?
qh: नसों में इंजेक्शन लगाने से पहले डॉक्टर सिरिंज से हवा के बुलबुले बाहर क्यों निकालते हैं?
o: To prevent venous Air Embolism that can occlude pulmonary or cerebral circulation
To avoid chilling the drug solution
e: Concept: IV injection me dawa seedha nadi me jaati hai aur khoon ke saath poore sharir me ghoomti hai - agar syringe me hawa ke bulbule (air bubbles) reh jaayein to wo khoon ke saath phephde ki dhamniyon me pahunch kar unko rok sakte hain - ise 'Air Embolism' kehte hain (aur brain tak jaaye to stroke) - isliye nurse/daktar hawa ka bulbula nikaal kar injection lagate hain. Baaki teen kaaran galat hain: volume maapna, needle ki dhaar, thand lagna - inka sambandh hawa nikaalne se nahi. Exam point: 'Syringe me hawa ke bulbule na chhodna = Air embolism se bachne ke liye (phephda/brain ki nali block)'.

qe: The specialized, flexible fibrocartilaginous and elastic structure of the external ear that directs sound waves is the:
qh: कान का बाहरी दिखाई देने वाला लचीला भाग जो ध्वनि तरंगों को इकट्ठा करता है:
e: Concept: Bahari kaan ka woh laal, chamakdar, lichakdar hissa jise hum chhoote-chhoote hilaa sakte hain - Pinna (Auricle) - ka kaam hai hawa me chalti awaaz ki lehron ko ikahtt ka aakar unhe kaan ki nali me bhejna; ye fibrocartilage aur elastic cartilage se bana hota hai (isliye lacha dar aur mod sakte hain) aur iske bez uske khand bajane (sound localisation) me bhi madad hoti hai. Baaki teen andar ke parts hain: Eustachian tube (pressure), Cochlear duct (sunna), Tympanic membrane (kanneri). Exam point: 'Bahari kaan ka awaaz ikattha karne wala hissa = Pinna (auricle)'.

qe: What physiological sensory conflict precipitates 'Motion Sickness' (car/sea sickness nausea and vomiting)?
qh: यात्रा के दौरान होने वाली 'मोशन सिकनेस' (उल्टी और चक्कर) का मुख्य कारण क्या होता है?
o: Sensory mismatch between visual inputs from the eyes and vestibular balance signals from inner ear semicircular canals
e: Concept: Motion sickness (jaise gaadi/naav me ji michalna, ulti) ka asli kaaran ek 'conflict' (takrav) hai: kaan ke andar ke semicircular canals (vestibular system) ko lagta hai ki sharir hil raha hai (accelerate/ghoom raha hai), par aankhen (visual input) dekh rahi hain ki sab kuch sthir hai (ya ulta) - dimaag ko ye mila jula signal samajh nahi aata aur wo ulti/michli ka signal de deta hai. Isliye aankh band karna ya door (horizon) dekhna aaram deta hai. Baaki teen galat hain: sugar, BP, acid - ye iska kaaran nahi. Exam point: 'Motion sickness = aankhon aur kaan (vestibular) ke signal ka mismatch'.

qe: Which dense, white, fibrous connective tissue bands specifically anchor skeletal muscles to periosteal bone surfaces?
qh: मांसपेशियों को हड्डियों से जोड़ने वाले मजबूत रेशेदार संयोजी ऊतक क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Concept: Jab muscle sikudta hai to use haddi par khichaav (tension) dena hota hai - ye kaam tendon karte hain: ye moti, safed, reshedaar fibrous band hote hain jo muscle ke sire ko haddi ke periosteum (haddi ki bahari jhilli) se jodte hain; jaise Achilles tendon (edi ki nas). Baaki teen alag structures hain: Aponeurotic fascia (chapta parda), Ligaments (haddi-haddi ka jod), Synovia (joint ka tezab). Exam point: 'Muscle se haddi = Tendon'.

qe: Which strong, flexible, elastic fibrous bands bridge articular joints to connect 'Bone to Bone'?
qh: जोड़ों को स्थिरता प्रदान करने और 'हड्डी को हड्डी' से जोड़ने वाले ऊतक क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Concept: Ligament wo mota, lachakdar fibrous band hota hai jo ek haddi ko doosri haddi se jodta hai aur joint (jod) ko mudne-ghoomne me madad deta hai par usse alag (dislocate) nahi hone deta - jaise ghutne ke andar ke cruciate ligaments khel (football) me chhoot jate hain. Baaki teen alag hain: Synovial membrane (joint ke andar ka aavaran jo fluid banata hai), Tendons (muscle-haddi), Articular bursae (ghisav kam karne wali chhoti thaili). Exam point: 'Haddi se haddi ka jod = Ligament; muscle se haddi = Tendon'.

qe: Ball and Socket (Enarthrodial) synovial joints, which permit multi-axial 360-degree rotational mobility, are located at the:
qh: सभी दिशाओं में (360°) घूमने की अनुमति देने वाली कंदुक-खल्लिका (बॉल एंड सॉकेट) संधि कहाँ पाई जाती है?
e: Concept: Joint me jis hisse me gundhi (gola) khaandhe me baithi hoti hai - jahan gundh (ball) kisi katora (socket) me ghoomti hai aur harkat kai aksh (multi-axial, 360 degree) me ho sakti hai - use Ball and Socket (Enarthrodial) joint kehte hain; aise joints sirf do hain: kandhe (shoulder - glenohumeral) aur koolhe (hip - iliofemoral) - isliye ye sabse zyada ghoomne wale joints hain. Baaki teen alag joints/movements hain: Carpal (wrist), Elbow/Knee (hinge), C1-C2 (pivot). Exam point: '360 degree ghoomne wale ball-and-socket joints = Shoulder + Hip'.

qe: Hinge (Ginglymus) synovial joints, which permit uniaxial angular movement similar to a swinging door, are found at the:
qh: दरवाजे के कब्जे की तरह केवल एक ही दिशा में मुड़ने वाली 'कब्जा संधि' (Hinge Joint) कहाँ पाई जाती है?
e: Concept: Hinge (Ginglymus) joint ek darwaze ke kabje (hinge) ki tarah kaam karta hai - sirf ek hi aksh (uniaxial) me mudta (bend) aur khulta (straighten) hai jaisa hath-pair modna; aise joints hain: kohni (elbow - humerus-ulna) aur ghutna (knee - femur-tibia). Isliye ye sabse zyada samajhne me aasan aur workout me kam chot wale joints hain. Baaki teen alag joints hain: Thumb carpometacarpal (saddle), Hip (ball and socket), Radioulnar (pivot). Exam point: 'Elbow aur Knee = Hinge joints (uniaxial, darwaze ki tarah)'.

qe: The specialized Saddle joint granting the human thumb its unique opposable dexterity is situated at the:
qh: मानव अंगूठे को वस्तुओं को पकड़ने के लिए लचीली गति देने वाली 'सैडल संधि' (Saddle Joint) कहाँ स्थित होती है?
o: Carpometacarpal joint of the thumb (between trapezium and 1st metacarpal)
e: Concept: Saddle joint ek ghodhe ki kaathi (saddle) jaisa joint hota hai jisme ek haddi ki surface doosri par aise baithti hai ki do alag-aaksh (biaxial) me ghoom sake; andhe ke anguthe (thumb) me 'trapezium' aur pehli metacarpal ke beech yahi joint hota hai jiske kaaran hi thumb ko 'opposable' (dusri ungliyon ka samna karne ki shakti) milti hai - isi wajah se hum pen pakad paate, cheezein utha paate hain. Baaki teen alag joints hain: Acromioclavicular, Sternoclavicular, DIP (ungli ka aakhri jod). Exam point: 'Andhe ka opposable thumb = Saddle joint (trapezium + 1st metacarpal)'.

qe: The Pivot (Trochoid) joint facilitating the rotational 'No' shaking movement of the human head is situated between:
qh: सिर को दाएँ-बाएँ घुमाने की अनुमति देने वाली 'खूँटी संधि' (Pivot Joint) किन दो कशेरुकाओं के बीच स्थित होती है?
e: Concept: Pivot (Trochoid) joint me ek dher (prot) ek chal me baithkar ghoomta hai, isliye ye sirf 'round' (rotation) wali harkat deta hai. Sir ko 'Na' ke liye hilaana isi ka kaam hai: ye C1 (Atlas) aur C2 (Axis) ke beech hote hain - Axis ke upar wale ubhre hisse (dens/odontoid process) par Atlas ghoomta hai, isliye sawaal me ye jodi sahi hai. Baaki teen alag jod hain: L5-Sacrum, C7-T1, aur occipital condyles-Atlas (ye 'yes' wala nod karta hai). Exam point: 'Sir ka hilaana (No wala rotation) = Atlas (C1)-Axis (C2) pivot joint'.

qe: The s-shaped horizontally oriented 'Collar Bone' that bridges the sternum to the scapular acromion is the:
qh: कंधे और स्टर्नम के बीच स्थित कॉलर बोन या 'ब्यूटी बोन' का वैज्ञानिक नाम क्या है?
e: Concept: Collar bone (Clavicle) ek 'S' shape ki lambi haddi hai jo seene (sternum) ke upar wale hisse se lekar kandhe ke 'Scapula' ke acromion tak jaati hai - ye kandhe aur dhad (trunk) ko jodne wala ekmatra haddi (bone) hai, isliye ye bahut ahem bhi hai aur sabse zyada tootne wali haddi (khaas kar girne par) bhi. Baaki teen dhad/kandhe ki haddiyan hain par collar bone nahi: Scapula (kandhe ka chapta haddi), Coracoid (scapula ka ubhaar), Sternum (chhati ki chapta haddi). Exam point: 'Collar bone (sternum se scapula tak) = Clavicle'.

qe: The large triangular flat bone situated on the posterior posterolateral thoracic wall is the:
qh: पीठ के ऊपरी हिस्से में स्थित कंधे की बड़ी त्रिकोणीय चपटी हड्डी (Shoulder Blade) को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Scapula ek 'tripod' (teen kone wala) chapta (flat) haddi hai jo seene ke peeche (posterolateral) ki taraf, kandhe ke pichhe rehti hai - ye kandhe ki aikili (ball and socket) joint me socket (glenoid canal) banati hai aur muscle ke latakne ki jagah deti hai (isliye kandha itna chalta hai); iske aage-peedhe chhote ubhaar (spine, acromion, coracoid) hote hain. Baaki teen haddiyan alag jagah hain: Clavicle (aage), Humerus (bahon ki haddi), Ilium (koolhe ki haddi). Exam point: 'Kandhe ke peeche ka chapta (triangular flat) haddi = Scapula'.

qe: How many cervical (neck) vertebrae are consistently found in the vertebral column of humans and nearly all mammals?
qh: मनुष्य और लगभग सभी स्तनधारियों की गर्दन में कितनी 'सर्वाइकल कशेरुकाएं' (Cervical Vertebrae) होती हैं?
e: Concept: Gardan (neck) ki haddiyon (cervical vertebrae) ki sankhya insaan aur lagbhag saare stanpaayiyon me ek jaisi hoti hai - 7 (C1 se C7). Khaas baat: mammoth (haathi) aur giraffe jaise lambi gardan wale bhi 7 hi hoti hain, bas unki haddiyan badi choti hoti hain; inhi me pehli (Atlas) aur doosri (Axis) sar ko hilati hain. Baaki teen numbers peeche wale spine ke hisse hain: 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar, 10 kisi ka nahi. Exam point: 'Cervical vertebrae = 7 (C1-C7; giraffe me bhi 7)'.

qe: How many thoracic vertebrae articulate with the 12 bilateral pairs of ribs in the human vertebral column?
qh: मानव रीढ़ की हड्डी के वक्ष (Thoracic) क्षेत्र में कितनी कशेरुकाएं पाई जाती हैं जो पसलियों से जुड़ती हैं?
e: Concept: Pasliyan (ribs) 12 jodiyan (pairs) hoti hain aur unke peeche ki taraf ki jod har ek pasli ko ek-ek 'thoracic vertebra' se jodti hai - isliye thoracic vertebrae bhi 12 (T1 se T12) hote hain; inme pasliyan, sternum aur seene ki haddiyan milkar chhati ka pinjara (cage) banati hain jo dil-phephde ko bachaata hai aur saans me madad karta hai. Baaki teen sankhyaayein doosre hisson ki hain: 4 (coccyx), 5 (lumbar), 7 (cervical). Exam point: 'Thoracic vertebrae = 12 (T1-T12, har ek se ek pasli ki jodi)'.

qe: How many large, weight-bearing vertebrae constitute the adult human 'Lumbar' (lower back) spine?
qh: कमर के निचले हिस्से में शरीर का अधिकांश भार वहन करने वाली कितनी 'लम्बर कशेरुकाएं' (Lumbar Vertebrae) होती हैं?
e: Concept: Kamar (lower back) ki haddiyan - Lumbar (L1 se L5) - sirf 5 hoti hain, par ye sabse moti, badi aur 'vajan uthane wali' hoti hain, kyunki poore dhade ka bhaar inhi par aata hai (isliye kamar dard/slip disc yahi hota hai). Baaki teen numbers doosre hisson ki hain: 7 cervical, 1 coccyx (ya kuch bhi nahi), 12 thoracic. Exam point: 'Lumbar vertebrae = 5 (L1-L5, sabse moti aur vajan uthane wali)'. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar 5 vertebrae (L1 to L5) hi hai. Is vishay ke ulte prashn bhi poochhe jaate hain, isliye dono taraf ka tathya saaf karna zaroori hai.

qe: The vestigial terminal segment of the adult human vertebral column representing the fused 'Tailbone' is the:
qh: मानव रीढ़ के सबसे निचले सिरे पर स्थित 4 जुड़ी हुई हड्डियों से बनी 'पूँछ की हड्डी' क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Insaan ke spine ke aakhir me ek chhota, jutaa hua (fused) hissa hota hai jise Coccyx (tailbone) kehte hain - ye humare un purakhon ki poonch (tail) ka bacha hua nishaan (vestigial) hai; isme 3-5 chhoti haddiyan juki hui hoti hain aur ye baithne me thoda sahara deta hai. Baaki teen koolhe (pelvis) ke hisse hain: Ischium, Pubis, Sacrum (ye 5 juki hui vertebrae se banta hai, coccyx se upar). Exam point: 'Katharun (tailbone) = Coccyx (vestigial; pelvis ka aakhri chhota hissa)'.

qe: What is the total number of consolidated, functional vertebrae in the spinal column of a normal human adult?
qh: एक वयस्क मनुष्य के कशेरुक दंड (रीढ़ की हड्डी) में कुल कितनी हड्डियाँ होती हैं?
e: Concept: Insaan ke janm ke waqt spine me 33 vertebrae (haddiyan) hoti hain, par bade hone par kuch jud (fused) jaati hain: 5 sacral milkar 1 Sacrum banti hain aur 3-5 coccygeal milkar 1 Coccyx, isliye adult me 'functional' (kaam karne wali alag) vertebrae 26 reh jaati hain: 7C + 12T + 5L + 1 Sacrum + 1 Coccyx = 26. Baaki teen numbers isliye galat hain: 20 aur 24 (sirf C+T+L ginti), 33 (janm ke waqt ki sankhya). Exam point: 'Adult spine = 26 functional vertebrae (33 janm ke baad, kuch milkar jud jaati hain)'.

qe: The anterior 'dagger-shaped' flat bone situated at the midline of the anterior thoracic chest wall is the:
qh: छाती के बीचोबीच स्थित चपटी हड्डी क्या कहलाती है जिससे पसलियां आकर जुड़ती हैं?
e: Concept: Seene ki saamne wali beech ki haddi ko Sternum (breastbone) kehte hain - ye ek 'khanjar (dagger) jaisi chapta haddi hai jo seene ke bilkul beech (midline) me hoti hai aur har taraf ki pasliyon (ribs) ke aage wale sire ko jodti hai (isse chhati ka pinjara banta hai, dil-phephde surakshit rehte hain); iske teen hisse hote hain: manubrium (upar), body (beech) aur xiphoid process (sabse neeche). Baaki teen alag haddiyan hain: Scapula (kandhe ke peeche), Clavicle (collar bone), aur Xiphoid sirf sternum ka ek aakhri hissa hai (poora sternum nahi). Exam point: 'Seene ki beech ki khanjar jaisi chapta haddi = Sternum (breastbone)'.

qe: Why are the 11th and 12th bilateral pairs of thoracic ribs specifically designated as 'Floating Ribs'?
qh: पसलियों के 11वें और 12वें जोड़े को 'फ्लोटिंग रिब्स' (Floating Ribs) क्यों कहा जाता है?
o: They float detached in pleural fluid
They articulate posteriorly with vertebrae but have completely unattached anterior ends
e: Concept: Pasliyon ki 12 jodiyan hoti hain; upar wali 7 'true ribs' hoti hain (seedha sternum se judi), 8-10 'false ribs' (upar wali pasli se judi, sternum se nahi) aur aakhri 2 jodiyan - 11th aur 12th - aage ki taraf bilkul kisi se nahi judi, unka samne wala sira khoon (free) rehta hai; isliye inhe Floating Ribs (tar rahi pasliyan) kehte hain. Baaki teen kaaran bilkul galat hain (fluid me tairna, saans me tootna, bone marrow ka na hona). Exam point: 'Floating ribs = 11th aur 12th pasli (aage se judi nahi hoti)'.

qe: What is the total count of individual rib bones constituting the protective thoracic rib cage in humans?
qh: मानव पसलियों के पिंजरे में पसलियों की कुल संख्या कितनी होती है?
e: Concept: Insaan ke chhati ke pinjare (thoracic rib cage) me chaaron taraf ki pasliyan kul 24 hoti hain (dono taraf 12-12 jodiyan) - ye pasliyan peeche se vertebrae se judi hoti hain aur aage ka zyada hissa sternum/cartilage se, jisse dil aur phephde surakshit rehte hain aur saans me chhati ka aakar badalne me madad hoti hai. Baaki teen numbers galat hain: 20 aur 12 (aadhi ginti), 26 (koi aisa sang nahi). Exam point: 'Total ribs = 24 (12 jodiyan)'.

qe: How many individual bones constitute the total anatomical 'Head Region' (including cranium, face, ears, and hyoid)?
qh: मानव के संपूर्ण सिर (कपाल, चेहरा, कान और हायॉइड सहित) में कुल कितनी हड्डियाँ होती हैं?
o: 29 bones (8 Cranial + 14 Facial + 6 Ear Ossicles + 1 Hyoid)
e: Concept: 'Head' (sar ka ilaaka) me sirf khopdi ki haddiyan nahi, poora set ginte hain: 8 cranial bones + 14 facial bones + 6 ear ossicles (kaan ki teen chhoti haddiyan dono taraf) + 1 hyoid = 29 bones. Isliye agar exam me poora head region poochha jaye to 29 aata hai. Baaki teen numbers aadhe hisse hain: 22 (sirf skull - cranial + facial), 14 (facial), 32 (koi sang nahi). Exam point: 'Head region total = 29 bones (8 cranial + 14 facial + 6 ear ossicles + 1 hyoid)'.

qe: Excluding the ear ossicles and hyoid bone, how many bones specifically form the articulated human 'Skull'?
qh: कान की हड्डियों और हायॉइड को छोड़कर मानव 'खोपड़ी' (Skull) में कुल कितनी हड्डियाँ होती हैं?
e: Concept: 'Skull' (khopdi) sirf un haddiyon ko kehte hain jo aapas me judne wale joda (suture) se juri hoti hain - matlab 8 cranial bones (dimaag ko gherne wali) + 14 facial bones (chehra banane wali) = 22; isme kaan ki chhoti haddiyan (ear ossicles) aur hyoid nahi ginte (wo alag 'head region' me hain). Baaki teen numbers iske hisse hain: 8 (sirf cranial), 14 (sirf facial), 29 (poora head region). Exam point: 'Skull = 22 bones (8 cranial + 14 facial)'.

qe: How many individual bones assemble the skeletal architecture of the human 'Face'?
qh: मानव 'चेहरे' (Facial Skeleton) की बनावट में कुल कितनी हड्डियाँ होती हैं?
e: Concept: Chehra (face) 14 chhoti-moti haddiyon se bana hota hai - inme se 2 'Nasal' (naak), 2 'Maxilla' (upper jabda), 2 'Zygomatic' (gaal), 2 'Lacrimal', 2 'Palatine', 2 'Inferior nasal conchae', 1 'Vomer' (naak ka parda) aur 1 'Mandible' (lower jabda) hote hain. Isliye face = 14 bones (aur inme se sirf mandible hilta hai, baaki fixed). Baaki teen numbers doosre hisse hain: 22 (skull), 6 (ear ossicles), 8 (cranial). Exam point: 'Face = 14 bones (mandible hi hilne wala); skull = 22'.

qe: How many cranial bones fuse together via immovable sutures to enclose and protect the brain?
qh: मस्तिष्क को चारों तरफ से घेरने वाले कपाल (Cranium) में कुल कितनी हड्डियाँ होती हैं?
o: 8 bones (Frontal, 2 Parietal, 2 Temporal, Occipital, Sphenoid, Ethmoid)
e: Concept: Khopdi ka dimaag wala bhaag (cranium) 8 haddiyon se banta hai jo asaan-kar-chhap (immovable sutures) se judi hoti hain - 1 Frontal (matha), 2 Parietal, 2 Temporal, 1 Occipital (peeche), 1 Sphenoid, 1 Ethmoid; ye mil kar brain ke liye ek mazboot dhaancha (protection) banati hain; chhote bachche me ye sutures khuli (fontanelle/soft spot) rehti hain taaki sar bada ho sake. Baaki teen numbers alag hisse hain: 14 facial, 12 koi sang nahi, 22 poora skull. Exam point: 'Cranial bones = 8 (brain ki suraksha wali khopdi)'.

qe: Which solitary u-shaped bone in the anterior neck does not articulate with any other bone and is fractured during strangulation?
qh: गले में स्थित कौन सी 'U-आकार' की अकेली हड्डी किसी अन्य हड्डी से नहीं जुड़ती और गला घोंटने पर टूट जाती है?
e: Concept: Hyoid bone ek 'U' (aadha chandra) aakar ki chhoti haddi hai jo gardan ke aage, jabde ke neeche hoti hai - khaas baat: ye kisi bhi doosri haddi se nahi judi (sirf muscles aur ligaments se latki rehti hai), aur yahi wajah hai ki ye jabaan, gale aur nigalne ki muscles ko sahara deti hai (baat karne/nigalne me madad). Isi tarah latke hone ke kaaran gala dabane (strangulation) par ye turti hai. Baaki teen alag haddiyan/cartilages hain: Mandible (jabda), Cricoid aur Thyroid cartilage (larynx ke hisse). Exam point: 'Kisi haddi se na judi (sirf muscle se latki) gardan ki u-shaped haddi = Hyoid'.

qe: The lower jaw bone, which represents the strongest and ONLY freely movable bone of the human skull, is the:
qh: खोपड़ी की एकमात्र हिलने-डुलने वाली और चेहरे की सबसे मजबूत हड्डी कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Neeche wala jabda (mandible) khopdi ki sabse bari, mazboot aur ekmatra 'hilne wali' haddi hai - yahi ek 'immovable' skull me ghoomti hai, isliye hum kha sakte, bol sakte aur chehra bana sakte hain; ye dono taraf ke 'temporomandibular joint' se khulti-band hoti hai (isi jod me dard/kharabi se TMJ disorder hota hai). Baaki teen khopdi ki haddiyan hain par fixed: Zygomatic (gaal), Palatine, Maxilla (upper jabda - fixed, hilta nahi). Exam point: 'Skull ki ekmatra hilne wali haddi = Mandible (lower jaw)'.

qe: The massive oval opening at the base of the skull's occipital bone through which the medulla oblongata continues into the spinal cord is the:
qh: खोपड़ी के आधार पर स्थित वह बड़ा छिद्र क्या कहलाता है जिससे होकर स्पाइनल कॉर्ड रीढ़ में प्रवेश करती है?
e: Concept: Khopdi (skull) ke neeche wali haddi (occipital bone) me ek bada saa gol chhed hota hai - Foramen Magnum - jisse dimaag ka neeche wala hissa (medulla oblongata) bahar nikal kar spinal cord ban jata hai; isliye ye ek bahut ahem 'darwaza' hai aur isi ke dono taraf occipital condyles (khopdi ko C1 se jodne wale ubhaar) hote hain. Baaki teen doosre chhed hain: Foramen ovale (trigeminal nerve ke liye), Jugular foramen (khoon ki nadi ke liye), Obturator foramen (pelvis me). Exam point: 'Brain to spinal cord ka rasta (khopdi ke base me bada chhed) = Foramen magnum'.

qe: The stirrup-shaped bone of the middle ear ossicular chain, representing the SMALLEST and lightest bone in the human body, is the:
qh: मानव शरीर की सबसे छोटी और हल्की हड्डी कौन सी है जो मध्य कान में पाई जाती है?
e: Concept: Madhya kaan (middle ear) me teen chhoti haddiyan 'ossicles' ki mala hoti hai - Malleus (hammer), Incus (anvil) aur Stapes (stirrup) - jo kanneri ki kampan (vibration) ko bahut tez (amplify) karke andar wale kaan tak pahunchati hain. Inme sabse chhoti, halki aur titali jaisi haddi Stapes (stirrup) hai - lagbhag 3 mg wazan ki, aur yahi 'stapes' (jiski shape ghore ki rakaab jaisi hai) insaan ke sharir ki sabse chhoti haddi hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Hyoid gardan ka, Incus/Malleus bhi ossicles hain par stapes se badi. Exam point: 'Sabse chhoti haddi (stirrup) = Stapes (middle ear me)'.

qe: The massive, weight-bearing thigh bone representing the LONGEST, HEAVIEST, and STRONGEST bone in the human body is the:
qh: मानव शरीर की सबसे लंबी, भारी और सबसे मजबूत हड्डी कौन सी है जो जांघ में पाई जाती है?
e: Concept: Jaangh (thigh) ki haddi Femur insaan ke sharir ki sabse lambi (lagbhag 45-50 cm), sabse moti aur sabse mazboot haddi hai - ye koolhe (pelvis) se ghutne tak jaati hai; isi wajah se ye poore vaajan ka bada hissa uthaati hai (aur isiliye giraan par iska tutna bahut khatarnak hai, aur isme bahut khoon jama hota hai). Baaki teen haddiyan chhoti hain: Humerus (bahu), Tibia (pair ki badi), Fibula (pair ki patli). Exam point: 'Sabse lambi, moti aur mazboot haddi = Femur (jaangh ki haddi)'.

qe: The anterior shin bone of the lower leg, characterized by its palpable subcutaneous border and high density, is the:
qh: निचले पैर (पिंडली) की सामने वाली प्रमुख और सबसे चमकीली हड्डी कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Pair ke aage wali badi haddi Tibia (shin bone) hai - ye ghutne se takhne (ankle) tak jaati hai aur bimari ke waqt iska aage wala hissa chamdi ke bilkul neeche (subcutaneous) dikhta-mahsoos hota hai (khaas kar chot/dard me), aur poori pair ka vaajan uthaati hai (isliye ise 'weight-bearing' bone kehte hain). Baaki teen alag haddiyan hain: Fibula (side wali patli, bina vaajan uthane wali), Ulna (kolhe ki), Femur (jaangh). Exam point: 'Pair ki aage wali moti weight-bearing haddi = Tibia; side wali patli = Fibula'.

qe: The small triangular sesamoid bone embedded within the quadriceps tendon protecting the anterior knee joint is the:
qh: घुटने के जोड़ की रक्षा करने वाली कटोरी जैसी छोटी गोलाकार हड्डी को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Kuch haddiyan apne aap nahi, balki kisi tendon (nas) ke andar ek 'til' (sesamoid - sesam jaisi) ki tarah banti hain; ghutne ke aage wali Patella (kneecap) aisi hi sabse badi sesamoid haddi hai, jo quadriceps ki nas me baithi hoti hai aur ghutne ke joint ko aage se bachati hai + muscle ki strength badhati hai (isliye chot lagna aam hai). Baaki teen alag ubhaar/haddiyan hain: Olecranon (kohni ka ubhaar), Trochanter (koolhe ki haddi ka ubhaar), Fabella (ek chhota sesamoid jo kisi-kisi me hota hai). Exam point: 'Sabse badi sesamoid haddi (quadriceps tendon me) = Patella (kneecap)'.

qe: How many individual bones compose the entire adult human 'Appendicular Skeleton' dedicated to locomotion and manipulation?
qh: चलने-फिरने और हाथ-पैर की गतिविधियों के लिए जिम्मेदार 'उपांगी कंकाल' (Appendicular Skeleton) में कुल कितनी हड्डियाँ होती हैं?
o: 126 bones (60 Arms + 60 Legs + 4 Pectoral Girdle + 2 Pelvic Girdle)
e: Concept: Poora skeleton do hisson me bat jaata hai: axial (dhad - khopdi, spine, pasliyan) aur appendicular (haath-pair aur unke girdle). Appendicular skeleton me kul 126 haddiyan hoti hain: 60 dono baahon me + 60 dono pairon me = 120, aur 4 shoulder girdle (2 clavicle + 2 scapula) + 2 pelvic girdle (hip bones) = 126; aur bacha 80 axial me hota hai (80+126=206). Baaki teen numbers alag ginting hain: 64 (ek haath-pair ka), 206 (poora sharir), 80 (axial). Exam point: 'Appendicular skeleton = 126 bones (haath-pair + girdle); axial = 80'.

qe: How many bones assemble the entire anatomical framework of a SINGLE human upper limb (from shoulder joint to fingertips)?
qh: एक वयस्क मानव के एक हाथ (कंधे से उंगलियों तक) में कुल कितनी हड्डियाँ होती हैं?
o: 30 bones (1 Humerus + 1 Radius + 1 Ulna + 8 Carpals + 5 Metacarpals + 14 Phalanges)
e: Concept: Ek hi haath (upper limb) me 30 haddiyan hoti hain: 1 Humerus (bahu) + 2 (Radius + Ulna - kolhe ki dono haddiyan) + 8 Carpals (kai) + 5 Metacarpals (hatheli) + 14 Phalanges (ungliyan) = 30. Isliye dono haath me 60 haddiyan hoti hain. Baaki teen numbers alag ginting hain: 27 (phalanx hisse ka alag jod), 32 (thoda zyada), 14 (sirf phalanges). Exam point: 'Ek haath = 30 bones (1+2+8+5+14)'. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Ant mein sahi chunav 30 bones (1 Humerus + 1 Radius + 1 Ulna + 8 Carpals + 5 Metacarpals + 14 Phalanges) hi thehrta hai. Is vishay ke ulte prashn bhi poochhe jaate hain, isliye dono taraf ka tathya saaf karna zaroori hai.

qe: How many small pebble-like short bones constitute the articulating human 'Wrist' (Carpus)?
qh: मानव कलाई (Wrist) के जोड़ में कितनी छोटी हड्डियाँ (Carpals) पाई जाती हैं?
e: Concept: Kai (wrist) ka jod chhote-chhote 'pebble' jaisi 8 haddiyon se banta hai jinhe Carpal bones kehte hain - ye do kataar (rows) me 4+4 lagi hoti hain aur ye mil kar kai ko mudne aur ghoomne ki alag-alag azaadiyan deti hain (isliye hum kai mod sakte hain); ye hi haddiyan kai me chot/ghisav (carpal tunnel) ki shikar hoti hain. Baaki teen alag ginting hain: 14 (phalanges), 5 (metacarpals), 7 (tarsal - pair me). Exam point: 'Kai (carpals) = 8 chhoti haddiyan'.

qe: How many bones constitute the articulating ankle cluster (Tarsus) in a single human foot?
qh: मानव पैर के टखने (Ankle) में कितनी हड्डियाँ (Tarsals) पाई जाती हैं?
e: Concept: Pair ke takhne (ankle) me 7 chhoti 'gol' haddiyan hoti hain jinhe Tarsal bones kehte hain - inme sabse bada 'Calcaneus' (edi ki haddi) hota hai jispar poora vaajan aata hai, aur 'Talus' jo pair ki haddiyon se jodta hai; ye 7 milkar takhne ko lachak (flexibility) dete hain. Baaki teen alag ginting hain: 5 (metatarsals), 8 (carpals - haath me), 14 (phalanges). Exam point: 'Takhun (tarsals) = 7 haddiyan (sabse bada = calcaneus/edi)'.

qe: How many phalanx bones (Phalanges) are distributed across the five digits of a single human hand or foot?
qh: एक हाथ या एक पैर की पाँचों उंगलियों में कुल कितनी हड्डियाँ (Phalanges) पाई जाती हैं?
o: 14 bones (2 in thumb/hallux, 3 in each of the other four digits)
e: Concept: Ungliyon ki haddiyan (phalanx/phalanges) ek haath ya ek pair me 14 hoti hain: anguthe (thumb/hallux) me 2 aur baaki chaar ungliyon me 3-3 = 2 + 4x3 = 14. Isliye ek haath/pair ki total 30 (haath)/ 26 (pair) haddiyon me sabse zyada hissa phalanges ka hota hai (dono haath-pair me milkar 56 phalanges). Baaki teen numbers galat hain: 15, 12, 10. Exam point: 'Phalanges (ek hand/foot) = 14 (angutha 2, baaki 3-3)'. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Aakhir mein sahi pehchan 14 bones (2 in thumb/hallux, 3 in each of the other four digits) hi milti hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: Which dense, specialized visceral connective tissue forms the soft, flexible framework of the nasal tip and external ear pinna?
qh: नाक की नोक और कान के बाहरी हिस्से में पाई जाने वाली लचीली और मुलायम संरचना क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Naak ki tip aur bahari kaan ka lichakdar, naram dhaancha haddi se nahi, khaas 'visceral connective tissue' - Cartilage (khaas kar elastic aur hyaline cartilage) se banta hai; isme 'chondrocytes' cells aur ek laacha (flexible) matrix hota hai jisme khoon ki naliyan nahi hoti (isliye chot par ye dheere thik hota hai) - isi lachak ke kaaran naak-kaan mod sakte hain aur jhatke se nahi tootte. Baaki teen alag tissues hain: Spongy/cancellous bone, Dense regular tendon, Adipose fascia. Exam point: 'Naak ki tip aur kaan ka naram dhaancha = Cartilage (elastic/hyaline)'.

qe: What audible physical phenomenon produces the characteristic 'cracking' pop when hyperextending synovial knuckle joints?
qh: उंगलियों के जोड़ों को चटकाने पर आने वाली 'चटाक' की आवाज वास्तव में किस कारण से होती है?
o: Sudden snapping of deep flexor tendons
Cavitation: Rapid formation and collapse of dissolved gas bubbles within stretched synovial fluid
e: Concept: Ungliyan modne (khinchne) par jo 'kadak' ki awaaz aati hai wo asal me 'Cavitation' hai: synovial fluid me ghuli hui gases (CO2 etc.) ke bulbule achaanak bante hain aur phatte hain - usi se pop sunai deta hai; dhyaan dein ki isse kuch der ke liye joint alag (jada) ho jata hai aur usi ungli ko dobara turant kadak karne me reh jata hai (gases ko wapas ghulne me samay lagta hai). Baaki teen kaaran galat hain (cartilage ki ghisav, condyle ka tootna, tendon ka snapping). Exam point: 'Ungli kadakne ki awaaz = Cavitation (synovial fluid ke gas bulbs ka phatna)'.

qe: The specialized, slippery viscous transudate that lubricates diarthrodial joints and nourishes articular cartilage is:
qh: हड्डियों के जोड़ों के बीच घर्षण कम करने और चिकनाई देने वाला द्रव कौन सा होता है?
e: Concept: Diarthrodial (hilne wale, movable) joints ke andar ek 'kapkapi' (slippery, viscous) taral hota hai - Synovial Fluid - jo ek transudate hai aur synovial membrane se banta hai; iske do mukhya kaam hain: (1) jod ki surface ko chikna karke ghisav (friction) kam karna (lubrication) aur (2) articular cartilage ko poshan dena (kyunki cartilage me khoon ki naliyan nahi hoti, isliye khana yahin se aata hai). Baaki teen alag fluids hain: Lymphatic, Peritoneal, CSF. Exam point: 'Movable joints ka lubricating/nourishing fluid = Synovial fluid'.

qe: The scientific academic discipline dedicated to the study of the structure, pathology, and development of teeth is:
qh: दाँतों की संरचना, विकास और उनके रोगों के अध्ययन के विज्ञान को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Dant (teeth) ke dhaanche, unki bimariyon aur vikas ka alag adhyayan ek shastr me hota hai - Odontology; isme danton ki ginti (dental formula), unke hisse (enamel, dentine, pulp), aur unki bimariyan (caries, pyorrhea) sab padha jata hai (jabki dentistry ilaaj karta hai aur iska bada hissa forensic science me umar/identity batane ke liye bhi use hota hai). Baaki teen alag shastr hain: Osteology (haddiyan), Periodontics (dant ke aas-paas ka ilaaj), Orthopedics (haddi/joint ka ilaaj). Exam point: 'Dant ka adhyayan = Odontology'.

qe: What is the hardest, most mineralized substance in the human body, covering the anatomical crown of the tooth?
qh: मानव शरीर का सबसे कठोर और सर्वाधिक खनिजीकृत पदार्थ कौन सा है जो दाँत के ऊपरी भाग को ढकता है?
e: Concept: Insaan ke sharir ka sabse hard aur sabse zyada mineral wala padarth tooth enamel hai (lagbhag 96% mineral - hydroxyapatite calcium phosphate), jo dant ke upar wale hisse (crown) par chadha hota hai; ye itna mazboot hai ki chabane ka dabav sah leta hai - par khaas baat: ismein cells/nerves nahi hote, isliye ye khud ko theek nahi kar sakta (caries/acid se jo gayab ho gaya, wo wapas nahi aata). Baaki teen alag layers hain: Bone cortical plate, Cementum (jad wale hisse par), Dentine (enamel ke neeche ka hissa). Exam point: 'Sharir ka sabse hard padarth = Tooth enamel (calcium phosphate; khud repair nahi hota)'.

qe: The massive calcified layer situated directly beneath the enamel, forming the primary bulk of the tooth structure, is:
qh: इनेमल के ठीक नीचे स्थित दाँत का मुख्य और सबसे बड़ा आंतरिक भाग क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Dant ke andar enamel ke neeche ek aur moti, kalk wali parat hoti hai - Dentine - jo poore dant ka mukhya bhar (bulk) hoti hai; ye enamel se thodi naram (75% mineral) hoti hai, ismein microscopic naliyan (dentinal tubules) hoti hain jo pulp (nerves) tak jaati hain - isliye ispar acid/keede ka hamla pahunchte hi thand/garmi me tez dard hota hai. Baaki teen alag hisse hain: Alveolar bone (dant ko pakadne wali haddi), Dental pulp (nerve/vessels wala gudda), Gingival sulcus (masoodhe ki jeb). Exam point: 'Enamel ke neeche ka mota hissa (dant ka main bhar) = Dentine'.

qe: How many deciduous (temporary milk) teeth develop during early childhood before being exfoliated and replaced?
qh: मनुष्यों में कितने दाँत 'डाईफियोडॉन्ट' (Diphyodont) होते हैं, जो बचपन में टूटकर जीवन में दोबारा निकलते हैं?
e: Concept: Chhote bachchon ke dant (milk teeth/deciduous) 20 hote hain - ye 6-8 mahine me nikalna shuru karte hain aur 2-3 saal tak poore aa jate hain (aur 6-12 saal me tut kar latakte hain, unki jagah pakke dant aate hain); inme molar sirf 2-2 jodi (kul 8) hote hain aur premolar bilkul nahi hote. Baaki teen numbers galat hain: 12, 32 (pakke dant), 16. Exam point: 'Milk (deciduous) teeth = 20'. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Sabhi baaton ke baad 20 Milk Teeth hi theek uttar hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: The human permanent adult dental formula for one quadrant of the jaw is represented as:
qh: वयस्क मनुष्य का दंत सूत्र (Dental Formula) क्या होता है?
e: Concept: Kisi bhi insaan ke aadhe jabde (ek quadrant) ke dant ki ek 'dental formula' hoti hai: 2123 - yaani 2 Incisors (kutne wale), 1 Canine (tivra), 2 Premolars, 3 Molars; isliye poore muh me 4 x 8 = 32 pakke dant hote hain (dono upar-neeche, bayen-daayen). Baaki teen formulas galat hain (2213, 2102 - ye milk teeth ka, 1223). Exam point: 'Permanent dental formula (ek quadrant) = 2123; total = 32'. Inka is tathya se koi talmel nahi hai. Is prashn ka theek jawab 2123 (2 Incisors, 1 Canine, 2 Premolars,... hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: Which specific tooth category is completely ABSENT from the deciduous primary dentition of small children?
qh: छोटे बच्चों के दूध के दाँतों के सेट में कौन से दाँत पूरी तरह से अनुपस्थित होते हैं?
e: Concept: Chhote bachchon ke doodh ke danton (milk teeth) ki formula 2102 hoti hai - matlab 2 Incisors, 1 Canine, 0 Premolars, 2 Molars; isliye inme Premolars (jabde ke beech ki do-ub wali dant) poore hi nahi hote - wo sirf pakki (permanent) dentition me aate hain (aur milk teeth me aakhri Molars hoti hain jo baad me nikal jati hain). Baaki teen teeno milk teeth me hote hain: Incisors, Canines, First Molars. Exam point: 'Milk teeth me missing dant = Premolars (permanent me 8 aate hain)'.

qe: The sharp, pointed teeth positioned directly beneath the eyes, adapted for gripping and tearing flesh in carnivores, are:
qh: भोजन को चीरने-फाड़ने के लिए उपयोग किए जाने वाले नुकीले दाँत (Eye Teeth) क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Concept: Canines (kuchh ke 'tivra dant', jise 'eye teeth' bhi kehte hain - kyunki upar wale canine ki jad aankh ke bilkul neeche hoti hai) sabse tikshna (sharp, pointed) dant hote hain - inka kaam khaane ko pakadna aur khaas kar khaas kar flesh ko faadna hai; insaan me ye (kuch nahi khaate) phir bhi bolne aur gap dikhane me madad karte hain. Baaki teen alag kaam ke dant hain: Incisors (katna), Premolars (peesna), Molars (peesna). Exam point: 'Flesh pakadne-faadne wale tivra dant = Canines (eye teeth)'.

qe: The massive, elongated, continuously growing ivory tusks of modern elephants are morphologically modified:
qh: हाथी के बाहर निकले हुए विशाल दाँत (Tusks) वास्तव में किस दाँत का रूपांतरित रूप हैं?
e: Concept: Haathi ki lambi 'daant' (hathi daant/ivory tusks) asal me dant hi hain - morfologically ye Upper Central Incisors (upar ke beech wale katne wale dant) hote hain, jo bahut lambe hote hain aur zindagi bhar badhte rehte hain (aur munh se bahar nikalte rehte hain) - inhe log 'tusks' (ivory) kehte hain aur hathi inhe bachchon ko haatha-aur-ladne me use karta hai. Baaki teen teeno galat hain (lower canines, upper canines, premolars) - hathi me tusk incisors hi hota hai. Exam point: 'Haathi ke tusk = modified upper central incisors (zindagi bhar badhte hain)'.

qe: Dental caries (cavities and enamel demineralization) clinically begins when the pH of oral saliva drops below:
qh: मुँह का pH मान कितने से कम होने पर दाँतों के इनेमल का क्षरण (सड़न/Cavity) शुरू हो जाता है?
e: Concept: Dant me cavities (dental caries) tab shuru hoti hain jab mu'h ki laar (saliva) ka pH 5.5 (acidic threshold) se neeche gir jata hai; laar me bacteria chini (carbohydrate) khaakar acid banate hain (lactic acid se plaque banta hai) jo enamel ka kalshiyum ghol deta hai (demineralization), isliye meetha/cheeni zyada khane aur brush na karne se cavity hoti hai. Baaki teen pH values neutral/alkaline hain (7.0, 8.2, 6.8) jahan dant surakshit rehte hain. Exam point: 'Dant me cavity shuru = saliva pH 5.5 se neeche (acidic threshold)'.

qe: Which snake venom category acts primarily as a neurotoxin by blocking acetylcholine receptors and paralyzing the respiratory system?
qh: कोबरा जैसे साँपों का कौन सा जहर तंत्रिका तंत्र पर हमला करके श्वसन तंत्र को पंगु (Paralyze) बना देता है?
e: Concept: Saanp ka zeher (venom) proteins/enzymes ka ek cocktail hota hai; jis venom ka mukhya hamla nervous system par hota hai - ye acetylcholine receptors ko block karke signal chalta nahi deta, isliye pehle muskel (muscles) kamzor, phir saans rukne ki wajah se maut hoti hai - use Neurotoxic venom kehte hain; iska classic udaharan Cobra, Krait aur samudri saanp hain. Baaki teen alag venom types hain: Cytotoxic (cells todna - kuch saanp), Hemotoxic (khoon/dil), Nephrotoxic (kidney). Exam point: 'Saans/nerve system ko block karne wala saanp ka zeher = Neurotoxic (Cobra, Krait)'.

qe: Which category of snake venom (e.g., Vipers) destroys endothelial tissues and causes massive intravascular coagulopathy or hemorrhage?
qh: वाइपर जैसे साँपों का कौन सा जहर लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं और रक्त के थक्कों को नष्ट करके आंतरिक रक्तस्राव पैदा करता है?
e: Concept: Kuch saanp (jaise Russell's Viper) ka venom khaas kar khoon aur khoon ki nadiyon par hamla karta hai: ye aadiyal (endothelial) cells todta hai aur khoon jamne ka pura system gadbad kar deta hai (intravascular coagulopathy), jisse andar-andar khoon riste rehta hai, chot se khoon nahi rukta, aur ang (kidney, brain) band ho jate hain - ise Hemotoxic venom kehte hain. Baaki teen alag venom types hain: Cardiotoxic (dil), Neurotoxic (nerves - Cobra), Myotoxic (muscles). Exam point: 'Khoon jamne/riste wala saanp venom = Hemotoxic (Vipers)'.

qe: Which essential ion is fundamentally required to generate depolarizing action potentials across the axon membrane at synapses?
qh: तंत्रिका कोशिकाओं (Neurons) में विद्युत संकेत और तंत्रिका आवेग उत्पन्न करने के लिए कौन सा आयन आवश्यक है?
e: Concept: Action potential (signal) banane ke liye neuron ki membrane par pehle Sodium (Na+) ion ka andar aana aur phir Potassium (K+) ka bahar jana zaroori hai - isi charge badlav se depolarization hoti hai; isliye synapse par signal pahunchane ke liye Na+ aur K+ dono ions fundamental hain (aur calcium (Ca2+) neurotransmitter chhodne ke liye). Baaki teen ions ye kaam nahi karte: Iodide (thyroid hormone), Iron (haemoglobin), Magnesium (blocking/relax - kam me cramps). Exam point: 'Nerve impulse (depolarization) ke liye zaroori ions = Sodium (Na+) + Potassium (K+)'.

qe: Which neurotransmitter is synthesized in the brain's mesolimbic pathway, mediating reward-motivated behavior and pleasure sensations?
qh: मस्तिष्क द्वारा आनंद, प्रेरणा और पुरस्कार (Reward) की अनुभूति कराने वाला प्रमुख न्यूरोट्रांसमीटर रसायन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Dopamine ek neurotransmitter hai jo dimaag ke 'mesolimbic pathway' (reward circuit) me banta hai aur humein khushi, utsah, inaam (reward) aur nasha ki anubhuti karata hai - isliye ise 'pleasure/reward chemical' kehte hain; isi ke aage chal kar kharab hone se addictions (nasha, juaa) aur Parkinson's (iski kami) jaisi bimariyan judi hain. Baaki teen is family ke nahi hain: Insulin (sugar ka hormone), Melatonin (neend), Bilirubin (pitta pigment). Exam point: 'Reward/pleasure wala neurotransmitter (mesolimbic pathway) = Dopamine'.

qe: Animals that maintain an independent, stable, constant internal core body temperature via homeostatic thermoregulation are:
qh: बाहरी वातावरण का तापमान बदलने पर भी अपने शरीर का तापमान स्थिर रखने वाले जीव (जैसे मानव व पक्षी) क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Concept: Kuch janwar apna andar ka temperature barabar (constant) rakhte hain - chahe bahar garmi ho ya thand - kyunki unka metabolism aur thermoregulation (homeostasis) ye control karta hai; ise Homeothermic (warm-blooded, 'Samtapi') kehte hain; insaan, pakshi aur stanpaayi isi kehlate hain (isliye insaan ka 37 C fixed rehta hai). Baaki teen alag hain: Ectothermic/Poikilothermic (thand-khoon - machhli/sarisrip jinka temperature bahar ke hisaab se badalta hai), Stenohaline (namak ki maatra ko le kar). Exam point: 'Constant internal temperature = Homeothermic (warm-blooded/samtapi)'.

qe: What physiological condition causes the right kidney to sit anatomically lower than the left kidney in the human abdomen?
qh: मानव शरीर में दाहिनी किडनी बाईं किडनी की तुलना में थोड़ी नीचे क्यों स्थित होती है?
o: Displacement by the massive bulk of the Liver on the right side
Downward gravitational pull of the stomach
e: Concept: Kidney pet ke peeche (retroperitoneal) jodi me hoti hain par dono ek barabar nahi: daayi kidney liver ke bade bhaar (mass) ke neeche dhakel di jaati hai, isliye wo bayi wali kidney se thodi neeche (2-3 cm) hoti hai - isi wajah se anatomy me dono kidney ek level par nahi hoti; ulta bayen taraf spleen (til) chhota hota hai jo dhakka nahi deta. Baaki teen kaaran galat hain (aorta, spleen, pet ki gravity). Exam point: 'Right kidney neeche = liver ke mass se dhakelna'.

qe: At what standard Fahrenheit temperature is whole blood stored in blood bank refrigeration to maintain viability?
qh: ब्लड बैंक में दान किए गए रक्त को खराब होने और बैक्टीरिया से बचाने के लिए किस तापमान पर रखा जाता है?
e: Concept: Blood bank me khoon jama kar ke rakhne ke liye use khaas thanda (refrigeration) temperature par rakha jata hai - lagbhag 4 se 6 C (Fahrenheit me 39.2-42.8 F) - jisme khoon ke RBC ki jeevan-kshamta theek rehti hai aur bacteria nahi barhte (blood bank me 35-42 din tak rakha ja sakta hai); ye normal freezer (0 C/0 F) se alag hai kyunki freeze karne se RBC phoot jaate hain. Baaki teen temperatures galat hain: 72 F (room), 98.6 F (body), 0 F (freezer). Exam point: 'Khoon ka storage temperature = ~4-6 C (39-43 F)'.

qe: What is the standard volumetric measure of whole blood collected during a single voluntary blood donation unit in India?
qh: भारत में स्वैच्छिक रक्तदान के दौरान 'एक यूनिट' (One Unit) रक्त में सामान्यतः कितना रक्त लिया जाता है?
e: Concept: Ek baar blood donation (rakt daan) me lagbhag 350 ml khoon liya jata hai (kai jagah 450 ml bhi, khaas kar 60 kg se zyada wazan wale donors se) - blood bank ki ek 'unit' (jholi) yahi hoti hai; ek sehatmand vyakti isse koi nuksaan nahi hota kyunki sharir kuch hafton me khoon wapas bana leta hai (aur donor se 3-4 mahine ka gap rakha jata hai). Baaki teen numbers galat hain: 200 (chhota), 1000 (bahut zyada), 100 (bohot kam). Exam point: 'Ek blood donation unit = 350 ml (450 ml bade donors me; gap 3-4 mahine)'.

qe: Which blood gas exhibits an affinity for human hemoglobin approximately 200 to 250 times greater than oxygen, causing rapid asphyxiation?
qh: कौन सी विषैली गैस हीमोग्लोबिन से ऑक्सीजन की तुलना में 200 गुना अधिक तेजी से जुड़कर दम घोंट देती है?
e: Concept: Carbon Monoxide (CO) - jo angithi, gas geyser, gaadi ke dhuaan me banta hai - haemoglobin se chipakne me oxygen se 200-250 guna zyada shakti rakhta hai aur CO-haemoglobin ek bahut hi sthir (stable) compound banata hai; isliye kam matra me bhi haemoglobin CO se bhar jata hai, oxygen nahi pahunchti aur insaan ki saans ghut kar maut ho jati hai (aur kyunki CO rang-bu-bina hai, pata bhi nahi chalta). Baaki teen gases ka itna zehar nahi: CO2, SO2, N2. Exam point: 'Haemoglobin se O2 se 200-250 guna zyada chipakne wali gas = Carbon monoxide (silent killer)'.

qe: Why is burning charcoal or angithi in a completely sealed, unventilated room during winter dangerously lethal?
qh: सर्दियों में बंद कमरे में अंगीठी या कोयला जलाकर सोना जानलेवा क्यों साबित होता है?
o: Soot particles block the trachea mechanically
Incomplete combustion produces invisible Carbon Monoxide gas that suffocates occupants in their sleep
e: Concept: Band (sealed) kamre me angithi/charcoal jalaane par oxygen kam ho jati hai aur aadha (incomplete) jalne se Carbon Monoxide (CO) gas banti hai - ye gas rang-bu-bina hoti hai, isliye neend me pade logon ko pata hi nahi chalta; pet me ye hemoglobin se jud (oxygen se 200-250 guna zyada) kar khoon ko bekear kar deti hai aur neend me hi insaan ki maut ho jati hai (isliye kai log sad jaate hain). Baaki teen kaaran bilkul galat hain (heat se brain pighalna, soot se naliband, pressure ka teen guna hona). Exam point: 'Band kamre me angithi = CO (carbon monoxide) ka zeher (silent death)'.

qe: How many individual skeletal chambers constitute the tubular, multi-segmented heart of a common cockroach (Periplaneta americana)?
qh: तिलचट्टे (Cockroach) के लंबे नलिकाकार हृदय में कितने कोष्ठक (Chambers) पाए जाते हैं?
e: Concept: Tilchatta (cockroach - Periplaneta americana) ka dil insaan jaisa nahi, ek lambi nali (tubular) ki tarah hota hai jo back me (dorsal) poori badi ki lambai tak chalta hai aur 13 khaano (chambers) me bata hota hai - har khaane me chhote chhed (ostia) hote hain jisse khoon (haemolymph) andar-bahar aata hai (open circulation). Baaki teen numbers galat hain (8, 2, 4 - ye doosre janwar ya galti hain). Exam point: 'Tilchatte ka heart = 13 chambers (dorsal tubular heart)'.

qe: How many cardiac chambers constitute the branchial, single-circuit heart of cartilaginous and bony fishes?
qh: मछलियों के हृदय में कितने कोष्ठक (Chambers) पाए जाते हैं जो केवल अशुद्ध रक्त पंप करते हैं?
e: Concept: Machhliyon (cartilaginous aur bony) ka heart sirf 2 chambers ka hota hai: 1 atrium (khoon lene wala) + 1 ventricle (khoon bahar bhejne wala) - isse khoon ek hi baar heart se guzarta hai aur seedha gills (gills) me jaata hai (single circulation); isliye machhli ka heart gair-oxygen wale (deoxygenated) khoon ko pump karta hai. Baaki teen numbers doosre janwar ke hain: 4 (insaan/pakshi), 3 (ubhaychar - parichar frogs me 3 chambers - 2 atrium + 1 ventricle), 1 (kabhi nahi). Exam point: 'Machhli ka heart = 2 chambers (1 atrium + 1 ventricle; single circulation)'.

qe: Why do predatory birds (owls) exhibit exceptional visual acuity in total darkness but lack sharp diurnal color vision?
qh: उल्लू रात के अंधेरे में तो बहुत स्पष्ट देख सकता है परंतु दिन में रंगों को ठीक से क्यों नहीं पहचान पाता?
o: Retina is overwhelmingly packed with Rod cells (rhodopsin) with minimal Cone photoreceptors
e: Concept: Ullu (owl) raat me bahut tez dikhta hai par range (rang) kam dikhta hai - kyunki unki retina (parde) me bahut zyada 'Rod' cells (jo dhundhle roshni me kaam karte hain aur Rhodopsin pigment rakhte hain) hote hain aur 'cone' (range ke liye) bahut kam; isliye wo raat ko shikar dekh leta hai par rangon ki duniya me kamzor hota hai (isliye ullu ki aankhen aage ki taraf hoti hain - binocular vision). Baaki teen kaaran galat hain (cornea blue absorb karna, vessels ka na hona, lens ka apardh hona). Exam point: 'Ullu raat me dikhta hai = retina me rods zyada, cones kam'.

qe: Why do prey herbivorous mammals (rabbits, deer, goats) have eyes situated laterally on the sides of their cranium?
qh: शाकाहारी जीवों (जैसे हिरण, खरगोश) की आँखें सिर के दोनों किनारों पर क्यों स्थित होती हैं?
o: To provide an expansive panoramic field of view (~360 degrees) to detect stalking predators
To improve forward binocular 3D depth perception
e: Concept: Khargosh, hiran, bakri jais e shikar (prey) wale herbivores ki aankhen sar ke dono kinaron (lateral) par hoti hain - isse unka field of view lagbhag 360 degree ho jata hai (aage-peeche sab dikhta hai), jisse wo peeche se aate shikari (predator) ko jaldi dekhkar bhaag sakte hain - bas iske badle me unhe aage ka '3D depth' (binocular vision) kam milta hai (isliye doori ka andaza kam lagta hai). Baaki teen kaaran galat hain (binocular 3D, dhoop me sona, dhool se bachna). Exam point: 'Shikar wale herbivores ki aankhen side me = 360 degree panoramic view (predator dekhne ke liye)'.

qe: The specialized, hollow, fatty adipose tissue hump of a camel functions biologically as an adaptive reservoir of:
qh: ऊँट का कूबड़ (Hump) मुख्य रूप से किसका संचित भंडार होता है जो उसे रेगिस्तान में ऊर्जा देता है?
o: Dense triglycerides (Fat) that metabolize into energy and metabolic water
e: Concept: Oont ki peeth ka kuub (hump) asal me 'paani ki tank' nahi, moti charbi (dense triglycerides/adipose) ka bhandar hota hai - jab oont ko lambe samay tak khaana-paani nahi milta, to ye charbi tootkar energy banati hai aur isi metabolism ke dauran 'metabolic water' bhi paida hoti hai (aur isi charbi ke kaaran unhe dhoop me bhi kam paseena aata hai, paani bachta hai); oont ke paas is charbi ke kaaran bhookh-pyaas ko lambe samay tak sahne ki shakti hoti hai. Baaki teen galat hain (pure water, glycogen, bile salts). Exam point: 'Oont ka kuub = charbi (fat) ka bhandaar (energy + metabolic water)'.

qe: Which aquatic egg-laying monotreme mammal represents an evolutionary bridge by possessing mammary glands without teats?
qh: वह कौन सा दुर्लभ स्तनधारी जीव है जो बच्चे देने के बजाय अंडे देता है (Oviparous Mammal) परंतु बच्चों को दूध पिलाता है?
e: Concept: Mammal (stanpaayi) ki pehchaan doodh pilaana hai; par duniya me ek purani group hai jisme madaayein doodh banati hain par unke than (nipples) nahi hote - ye milk unki chamdi ki dhaar (gland) se riste hue bachche chaat lete hain; inhe Monotremes (egg-laying mammals) kehte hain aur inme Duck-billed Platypus (aur Echidna) aate hain - ye 'bridge' ki tarah hain kyunki ye egg deti hain aur doodh bhi pilati hain (evolution ka beech ka kadam). Baaki teen typical mammals/groups hain: Fruit Bat, Kangaroo (marsupial - pouch), Blue Whale (placental). Exam point: 'Egg dene wala + than ke bina doodh dene wala mammal = Platypus (monotreme)'.
